title: Trouvez un RDV pour une coiffure à domicile près de chez vous - RDV360

facts.fact: Indicative price for a haircut (coupe) at home is between 10 and 15 EUR, according to the page.
Indicative price for a coloration at home is between 16 and 20 EUR, according to the page.
Indicative price for a bridal hairstyle (coiffure de mariée) at home is between 90 and 120 EUR, according to the page.
Indicative price for a brushing at home is between 15 and 19 EUR, according to the page.
Indicative price for a haircut plus brushing at home is between 25 and 29 EUR, according to the page.
Indicative price for a mèche à palette (highlight) at home is between 41 and 51 EUR, according to the page.
Indicative price for a mèche à palette plus haircut at home is between 51 and 61 EUR, according to the page.
Indicative price for a balayage at home is between 80 and 150 EUR, according to the page.
According to the page, home hairdressing prices in the provinces are generally lower by 10 to 20 EUR than in the cities.
facts.quote: En province par exemple, ils sont généralement minorés de 10 à 20€.

facts.fact: According to the page, the home hairdressing service is generally available until 19:00, and later appointments can be arranged depending on urgency.
facts.quote: Ce service est généralement disponible jusqu’à 19h.

facts.fact: According to RDV360's own page, registration for professionals on its directory is free and carries no commission.
According to the page, home hairdressing prices vary from one city to another, and prices are set according to factors such as the length of hair and travel costs.
facts.quote: Il convient cependant de préciser que ces tarifs peuvent varier d'une ville à une autre.
